#w3cTPAC
Watch @lolaodelola present the Accessibility Compatibility Data (ACD) project:
➡️ https://youtu.be/XQpkWeYyqJk

In 2026, the project advanced efforts to integrate #accessibility support data into #developer tools such as the Browser Compatibility Data (BCD) and Baseline, with a proof of concept using Web Platform Tests and ARIA-AT data. Work continues on filling data gaps and defining support statuses, with a TPAC 2026 breakout inviting community input!
